patients.summary: Elementary school teacher with class I obesity who joined the practice in 2016. Three pregnancies under an outside OB group: a 2019-2020 pregnancy with a short cervix ending in a term vaginal birth, a 2022 pregnancy lost at 23 weeks to fetal osteogenesis imperfecta (COL1A1), and a 2025-2026 pregnancy with diet-controlled gestational diabetes ending in cesarean for arrest of labor; postpartum glucose tolerance normal.

documents.title: New Patient Call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller is a 25 y/o teacher in Amherst who wants a new PCP. Has been seeing a doctor near where she grew up and wants someone closer. BCBS PPO, card info taken. Membership agreement and intake packet emailed. New patient physical booked 9/13 at 3:40 pm (after school). Asked her to sign a release so we can get records from the old office - she will bring it to the visit.

orders.order: Records request, prior primary care office

documents.title: New Patient Visit - Establish Care
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Robin is 25, new to us, here to establish care and get a physical. Teaches second grade in town. Previously followed by a family doctor near her hometown, last physical about a year ago; she thinks the Pap there in 2015 was normal. Records release signed today.

No active complaints. Feels well. Says her weight has crept up since college, maybe 15-20 lb over a few years. Walks most weekends, no structured exercise during the school year. Eats lunch at school, lots of snacking in the afternoon by her account.

PMH: none other than weight. No surgeries. No hospitalizations.
Meds: none. No supplements.
Allergies: NKDA.
FH: maternal grandmother with type 2 diabetes. Parents well as far as she knows. No known bone or genetic disorders in the family.
SH: married, lives in Amherst. Never smoked. Doesn't drink. No drugs.
Gyn: regular cycles. Not currently trying to conceive, would like to in the next few years.
Vaccines: childhood series and HPV done as a teen per her mother; Tdap about 2 years ago - will confirm from records.

ROS negative in full.

Exam: vitals as charted, BMI 31. Well appearing. HEENT normal, sclerae white, TMs clear. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender, no masses. Extremities without edema. Skin without acanthosis. Mood and affect normal.

A/P
1. Preventive: CBC, CMP, lipids, TSH, A1c. HIV and hep C screen once - she agrees. Flu shot today. Pap not due until next year per her report; will confirm with records.
2. Obesity, class I (BMI 31). Talked through realistic goals - cut the afternoon snacking, aim for 150 min/wk walking. She'd like to try on her own. Recheck next year.
3. Preconception: when she is ready to try, start a prenatal vitamin a few months ahead. Let us know.

RTC 1 yr or sooner.

documents.title: Your recent lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Robin, nice to meet you this week. All of your blood work came back normal - blood counts, kidney and liver tests, thyroid, cholesterol and the diabetes screen (A1c). HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to do except keep working on the walking. See you next fall.

reports.text: Specimen: cervical, liquid-based preparation. Specimen adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation; endocervical/transformation zone component present. Interpretation: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
reports.conclusion: Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy (NILM).

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: MA
documents.body:
Received 14 pages by fax from patient's former family medicine office, covering 2009-2015. Abstracted for chart:
- Last physical 8/2015. Weight noted as "overweight/obese, counseled." No chronic problems otherwise.
- Pap 8/11/2015: NILM. Scanned to media.
- Immunizations: childhood series complete, HPV x3 (2005-2006), MMR x2, varicella x2, Tdap 7/22/2014.
- No medications. NKDA.
Routed to PCP for review.

documents.title: Outside records reviewed
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Reviewed prior records. Nothing surprising. Pap 2015 normal, next due 2018. Tdap 2014. Abstracted to chart.

documents.title: Form for school
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, our district wants an updated health form for staff before the field trip season (they want an immunization list mostly). Is that something you can fill out? I can drop it off. Thanks! - Robin

documents.title: RE: Form for school
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Hi Robin, yes - drop it at the front desk or upload it here and we will fill in the immunizations from your chart. Usually 2-3 business days.

documents.title: Form completed
documents.author: MA
documents.body: School staff health form completed from chart (immunizations, no restrictions), signed by PCP. Patient notified, picking up at front desk. Copy to media.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual. Robin is 26, doing well, back at school two weeks. No new problems. Weight up about 2 lb from last year. Says the snacking plan lasted a month or so. Walking on weekends still; summer was better.

Meds none. NKDA. Never smoker, no alcohol.
PHQ-2 0.

Exam: BMI 31. Well. Heart RRR, lungs clear, abd soft, ext no edema. Thyroid normal. Skin ok.

A/P
- Obesity class I: we talked about tracking food for a couple of weeks just to see the pattern, and adding a weekday walk after school. She will try an app. A1c today given grandmother with DM and weight.
- Flu shot given.
- Pap due next year.
- RTC 1 yr.

documents.title: A1c result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Robin - your A1c (3-month sugar average) is normal. No sign of diabetes or prediabetes. Keep going with the walking.

reports.text: Specimen: cervical, liquid-based preparation. Specimen adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation; endocervical/transformation zone component present. General categorization: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
reports.conclusion: Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

documents.title: Annual Physical with Pap
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
27F annual + Pap.

Interval: well. No visits in between. Weight up another couple of pounds; she gave up on the food app after a few weeks ("too much typing"). She and her husband are thinking about starting a family in the next year.

Meds none. NKDA. SH unchanged - teaching, never smoker, no EtOH.
LMP 9/10, cycles regular. No abnormal bleeding.
PHQ-2 0.

Exam: BMI 32. NAD. HEENT nl. Neck no thyromegaly. CV RRR no m. Lungs CTA. Abd soft NT. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, vaginal mucosa normal, cervix nulliparous without lesions, Pap obtained; bimanual no masses or tenderness. Ext no edema.

A/P
1. Health maintenance: Pap today (cytology alone at 27). CMP, lipids. Flu shot given.
2. Obesity class I, BMI 32 - discussed that getting some weight off before pregnancy helps, and the GDM risk with her weight + family history. She's motivated. Goal 5-7% loss. Offered nutrition referral, she declined for now.
3. Preconception: start a prenatal vitamin with folate once they start trying. She will message.

RTC 1 yr.

documents.title: Pap and lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Robin, your Pap came back normal. Next one in 3 years-ish (we'll switch to the Pap + HPV test after 30). Kidney, liver and cholesterol numbers were all fine too.
